meta.title: Iran Missile & Drone Tracker
meta.methodology: UAE MoD figures are official cumulative intercepts (highest confidence). Other Gulf state figures are working estimates from official MoD reports, ISW, and Wikipedia cross-referencing. Best-estimate totals include underreporting adjustments for Israel theater and other targets. Launcher estimates derived from IDF/ISW structured reporting. Pre-war stockpile estimates from Atlantic, NYT, IDF, and former US/Israeli officials.
caveats: Pre-Mar 19 data uses a different methodology (less structured, wider ranges)
Kuwait and Qatar cumulatives were significantly revised upward on Mar 23 after Wikipedia cross-reference
Saudi data is methodologically noisy; BM/CM split only available from Mar 20
Drone pre-war estimates range 30K-80K — extremely wide uncertainty
Launcher estimates are judgmental, combining hardware kills with C2/morale degradation
Production was ongoing early in the war but is assessed as halted for BMs since ~Mar 29
Cease-fire extended indefinitely Apr 22 at Pakistan's request; all figures frozen pending resumption or permanent deal
ISW Apr 19 / US officials to NYT: Iran dug ~100 launchers from underground storage during ceasefire; effective launcher count revised from ~102 to ~200 as of Apr 23
FDD/Long War Journal Apr 19: Kuwait revised to 369 BMs + 852 drones; Saudi revised to 68 BMs + 612 drones — Kuwait drone figure is ~30% higher than prior tracking estimate

Across all thirty, zero events fired on any of the seven enumerated read-grid channels — but they carry unequal weight under Rule B, and today's content is the one that carries the most. The IRGC naval channel is the primary Rule B FALSIFICATION indicator: a fresh seizure cluster is the single observable that would falsify the all-into-stalemate read and re-elevate the 23% rupture scenario. That channel is now Day 58 of silence since the Apr 22 seizure of two commercial ships (~8.3 weeks), and in 48 hours — Day 60, June 21 — it crosses into the Stena Impero (2019, ~10-week) historical hold-duration band, past the ~6-week MSC Aries (2024) and Niovi (2023) resolution windows. The two ships sit as frozen leverage, held but undeployed, and as the hold crosses the Stena Impero band the base-rate prior re-anchors decisively from "escalation opener" toward "single-event leverage trap." What a calendar month of naval silence DOES move is the compositional read beneath the 70/23 split — the cleanest evidence the falsification channel can produce that Rule B is holding.
